reasoning_steps: According to established molecular biology and guidance from global health authorities (including the CDC, WHO, and NIH), mRNA COVID-19 vaccines cannot alter or interact with human DNA
The mRNA delivered by the vaccine operates entirely within the cytoplasm of the cell, where ribosomes translate it into the target viral spike protein
It never enters the cell nucleus where genetic material (DNA) is kept
Furthermore, human cells do not possess the enzymes (such as reverse transcriptase and integrase) required to reverse-transcribe synthetic mRNA into DNA and integrate it into the human genome
The vaccine mRNA is fragile and is naturally degraded and cleared by normal cellular processes shortly after being translated.

claim_traces.claim_text: "Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short — around 5 feet 2 inches tall."
reasoning_steps: The claim that Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short (5 feet 2 inches) is a well-documented historical misconception
At his death, Napoleon's height was recorded as 5 pieds 2 pouces (French feet and inches)

Because the pre-metric French inch (*pouce*) was longer than the English inch (approximately 2.7 cm compared to 2.54 cm), his height translates to roughly 5 feet 6 inches to 5 feet 7 inches (about 1.67–1.69 m) in modern Imperial measurements
For a French male in the early 19th century, this was average or even slightly above average
The persistent myth of his diminutive stature was largely fueled by this unit discrepancy alongside contemporary British political caricatures and propaganda.
